main_body: Round leaf canopy (about rows 2-62) on a short, wide trunk with roots (rows 60-78)
top_band: Mid and light green leaf clumps on the upper canopy, rows ~2-14. This is a rounded foliage mass with no distinct flat band.
evidence: The canopy is a rounded organic volume, lit from above with light clumps at the top and darker foliage below. Dark gaps and branches sit under the canopy, and the trunk with roots is the visible front. It is not a flat elevation, a side profile or a top-down slab. There is no hard front-edge line, which is normal for foliage, but the shading does show a top and a front.

style.evidence: The canopy uses only three greens (dark, mid, light) plus a near-black outline, against the references' 5-6 steps with bright highlights and per-leaf clumps. The outline is a uniform near-black line around the whole silhouette, not a dark green tone. The dark green interior has large flat areas and the trunk is a nearly flat dark brown mass with few highlights. Clumps are dithered noise rather than shaped leaf clusters, so each tile carries fewer colours than the reference.
